title: Past continuous and pluperfect
summary: Tell a story in the past: set the scene with `-(I)yordu` (*Yağmur yağıyordu*), reach further back with `-mIştI` (*Film çoktan başlamıştı*), and hold it together with *o sırada*, *birden* and *çoktan*.
canDo: Say what was going on when something happened
Say what had already happened before a moment in the past
Ask and answer questions in the compound tenses
Tell a short story with a scene, events and earlier events
